connector.name: FindMe Photo
connector.registryDescription: Create wedding galleries, upload photos, and pull analytics on FindMe Photo from any AI assistant.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package findme-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the findmephoto account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: FINDME_API_KEY
env.description: Personal API key from https://findme.photo/settings/api (starts with fm_live_)
